## Summary

Found by the Step 7 (Axis 1 construct) sibling sweep while fixing `satiated-activated-aardwolf` (5524-e353-2e2d-4dbe). Same detect-only drift class as `CONFIG_PATHS`, but on the gerrit deploy-key materializer, which was overlooked when `materialize-g2p-config.sh` was added to `CONFIG_PATHS`.

`infra/gerrit/materialize-deploy-key.sh` is an SSM→file materializer (it puts the replication deploy key into the gerrit user's dir), a direct sibling of `infra/gerrit/materialize-g2p-config.sh`. `materialize-g2p-config.sh` IS enumerated in `CONFIG_PATHS` (detect-only, `reason=config_manual`); `materialize-deploy-key.sh` is in **no** manifest. So a merged change to the deploy-key materializer rsyncs to `/opt/rebar` and silently does nothing — the same drift class `CONFIG_PATHS` detect-only was created to make visible.

## Class-level plan (PRIMARY ticket for the manifest-omission class)

This ticket is the primary for a ONE class-level change fixing both confirmed instances of the class "an infra SOURCE that affects the running environment is absent from every path manifest in `infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh`, so a merged change to it drifts silently". The change touches ONLY `infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh` (two manifest additions) plus the new/extended regression tests. Sibling ticket `5d4c-a25b-b612-4aca` (broke-choleric-hound) is fixed in the same change.

Both instances proven at runtime with a discriminating contrast against the sibling source that IS in the manifest (see RCA comments on each ticket).

## Acceptance criteria (both instances are criteria)

- [ ] **Instance 1 (this ticket, DETECT-ONLY):** `infra/gerrit/materialize-deploy-key.sh` is enumerated in `CONFIG_PATHS` in `infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh`, so a deploy-key-materializer-only change emits `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR reason=config_manual` (parity with `materialize-g2p-config.sh`). Applying it touches gerrit — the same operator-judgement boundary as the rest of `CONFIG_PATHS` — so signal only, no auto-reload.
- [ ] **Instance 2 (sibling 5d4c, APPLY-PARITY):** `infra/scripts/mcp-entrypoint.sh` is enumerated in `MCP_PATHS`, so an entrypoint-source-only change rebuilds the MCP image via the EXISTING blue-green mcp deploy path (ADR 0079 v1 mcp auto-apply scope; reuse the existing path exactly — no new apply semantics).
- [ ] RED→GREEN regression test per instance (held out from the fixer), mirroring `tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_signals_gerrit_config.py` (instance 1) and `tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_mcp_bluegreen.py` (instance 2), each shown RED first and with mutation teeth (empty the manifest entry → back to RED).
- [ ] `observability.sh` already counts the `config_manual` signal (it counts every `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR {` regardless of reason) — verified, no observability change needed.
- [ ] `make lint` (incl. shellcheck) + full `tests/scripts` suite green.

## Structural guard (decided separately — NOT in this change)

A structural manifest-completeness guard for this class is being evaluated separately and is intentionally out of scope here. This change closes the two confirmed instances; any further same-class instances found are enumerated in the final report, not filed, per the sweep-containment directive.

## Evidence

- `CONFIG_PATHS='… infra/gerrit/materialize-g2p-config.sh …'` includes the g2p materializer but NOT `materialize-deploy-key.sh`.
- `grep -oE "^[A-Z_]+_PATHS='[^']*'" infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh | grep materialize-deploy-key` → no match.
- Runtime: deploy-key-materializer-only change → NO signal; g2p-materializer-only change → `config_manual` fires.

file_impact.reason: Instance 1: add infra/gerrit/materialize-deploy-key.sh to CONFIG_PATHS (detect-only, config_manual). Instance 2: add infra/scripts/mcp-entrypoint.sh to MCP_PATHS (apply-parity, existing blue-green mcp deploy). Two manifest-string additions only.
Instance 1 RED->GREEN: extend to assert AUTODEPLOY_ERROR reason=config_manual on a materialize-deploy-key.sh-only change, mirroring the existing gerrit.config signal test.

Instance 2 RED->GREEN: add a test that drives autodeploy under a git shim where only infra/scripts/mcp-entrypoint.sh changed and asserts the existing mcp blue-green deploy path fires (compose build mcp + upstream flip).
